title: Nonperturbative Stabilization of D-Instantons in the Bosonic IIB Matrix Model
summary: We study the bosonic type IIB (IKKT) matrix model and the fate of the D-instanton positions $p^{(i)}_μ$, the diagonal components of the $d$ Hermitian matrices, whose one-loop effective potential infamously drives them to a single point. We show that this collapse is an artifact of the leading (one-loop) truncation, while the actual non-collapse of the $p^{(i)}_μ$ is a nonperturbative effect: it is invisible at one loop but already present in the exact (all-loop) two-body interaction.
